papers.title: Time-R1: Time Series Forecasting as Reasoning — A Slow-Thinking Approach with Reinforced LLMs
papers.what: A two-stage RL fine-tuning framework (SFT + GRIP) that teaches LLMs multi-step reasoning for time series forecasting, bridging DeepSeek-R1 reasoning to the TS domain.

papers.title: CLAMP: Contrastive Self-Supervised Learning As Neural Manifold Packing
papers.what: A physics-inspired SSL framework that recasts contrastive learning as manifold packing using repulsive particle system potentials.

papers.title: TimeRecipe: A Time-Series Forecasting Recipe via Benchmarking Module Level Effectiveness
papers.what: A 10K-experiment benchmark that decomposes TS forecasting architectures into modules and ranks which component choices actually drive accuracy.

papers.title: Uncertainty-Driven Anomaly Detection for Psychotic Relapse Using Smartwatches
papers.what: Two smartwatch pipelines for daily psychotic relapse detection using Transformer encoders and ensemble uncertainty on cardiac, sleep, and motion signals.
